ladder.label: TOPPING
ladder.why: Daily momentum just crossed down and price lost its 10-day average mid-cycle. Last cycle was left-translated (topped early) — a bearish structural tell.
ladder.next: Trim or tighten stops; next likely support is the daily-cycle timing band (~day 36-42, now day 21).
ladder.regime_why: weekly momentum positive; last cycle left-translated (topped early)
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: MIXED — weekly momentum positive; last cycle left-translated (topped early) (investor cycle week 12 · daily cycle day 21).
ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): topping. Bigger picture (no clear trend): mixed.
points: Bigger picture is mixed (no clear trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity contracting — caution on the odds
Swing low printed (buyers rejected the low)
Prior cycle topped early (a tiring-trend hint)

entry.text: Momentum rolled over and the 10-day average is lost — reduce or tighten stops.
entry.text_zh: 动量已掉头向下且失守 10 日均线——减仓或收紧止损。

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 21 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 21 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 12 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: mid — the bigger up-leg is maturing
cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 12 周，典型周期为 16–26 周
cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 中期——更大的上行段正在成熟
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its FIRST half ('left-translated') — weak cycles top early, so this hints the bigger trend is tiring.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在前半段见顶（“左移”）——弱周期见顶偏早，这暗示更大的趋势正在走弱。

ladder.why_zh: 日线动量刚刚向下交叉，且价格在周期中段失守 10 日均线。 上一周期为左移结构（见顶偏早）——属于看空的结构性信号。
ladder.next_zh: 减仓或收紧止损；下一个可能的支撑是日线周期的时间窗口 （约第 36-42 天，现为第 21 天）。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：混合 — 周线动量为正；上一周期左移（见顶偏早）（投资者周期第 12 周 · 日线周期第 21 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：做顶中。大局（趋势不明）：混合。
points_zh: 大局为混合（对日线多头而言属趋势不明）
宏观：美国净流动性收缩——对概率属需谨慎
摆动低点已现（买方拒绝了该低点）
仍位于 10 日均线之下
日线动量刚刚向下交叉

ladder.liq_line: Macro headwind: US net liquidity is contracting — buy setups have historically had worse odds and deeper drawdowns here, so demand extra confirmation and smaller size. An odds edge, not a forecast.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 宏观逆风：美国净流动性正在收缩——在此环境下买入形态历史上胜率更低、回撤更深，因此应要求更多确认并降低仓位。这是概率优势，并非预测。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ TOPPING signal just triggered today (fresh cross from NEARING A LOW). Signal strength: moderate (score -50/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 做顶中信号于今日刚刚触发（全新交叉，自接近低点翻转）。 信号强度：中等（评分 -50/100）。
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：稳健卖出/离场形态（-57）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle high, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期高点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。

headline.en: Long-duration name into a restrictive, rising-real-rate regime — rate-neutral.
headline.zh: 长久期标的进入偏紧、实际利率上行的环境——利率中性。

detail.en: Own orthogonal rate (TLT) beta +0.89 ± 0.44 — medium precision. Sector anchor (XLC) reads long-duration (+0.10). Inflation-neutral.
detail.zh: 自身正交利率（TLT）beta +0.89 ± 0.44——精度中。 板块锚（XLC）为长久期（+0.10）。 通胀中性。

caveat.en: Single-name secondary betas are noisy — trust the portfolio aggregate, not any one stock's rate beta (measured out-of-sample persistence ≈ 0.36).
caveat.zh: 单一个股的次级beta噪声很大——应相信组合层面的汇总，而非任何单只股票的利率beta（实测样本外持续性约0.36）。
